title: Patient Pay Remittance, Refund and Case Closing Terms — Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
Residents and representatives on Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage remit patient pay, and receive refunds of credits, on the same terms on every tier.

| Term | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Accepted methods for patient pay | check, money order, ACH, transfer from the resident's trust account, transfer from funds the center receives as representative payee |
| Day of the month on which patient pay is transferred from funds the center receives as representative payee | the 5th |
| Written past-due notice | sent when a charge is still unpaid 30 calendar days after its due date |
| Refund of a patient pay credit | within 30 calendar days after the credit arises |
| Payee of a patient pay refund after the resident's death | the estate |
| A case may be closed only with a zero patient pay balance and a zero pending balance | yes |

**Notes.**

- A transfer from the resident's trust account and a representative payee transfer are accepted methods like the others; where the center is the resident's representative payee, the transfer happens on the 5th of each month.
- The past-due notice is written and is tied to the charge's due date: 30 calendar days after that date.
- A credit balance is refunded within 30 calendar days of arising; after a death the refund is paid to the estate.
- Closing requires both balances on the case — patient pay and pending — to stand at zero.
